component.name: 9M2PJU ESPHamClock
component.summary: Space weather, propagation and telemetry dashboard for radio amateurs

description.p: 9M2PJU ESPHamClock (Open HamClock - OHB Edition) is the premier open-source space weather, radio propagation, VOACAP modeling, satellite tracking, and telemetry dashboard designed for amateur radio operators worldwide.

ul.li: Direct hardcoded connectivity to the Open HamClock Backend (ohb.hamclock.app)
Live NOAA Space Weather: Solar Flux Index (SFI), Sunspots (SSN), Kp/Ap indices, SDO imagery
Real-time VOACAP point-to-point HF propagation prediction engine and band matrix
Live DX Cluster Telnet/Web ingestion and PSK Reporter FT8/FT4/CW live spot map pins
Amateur satellite tracking (ISS, AO-91, RS-44) with Doppler shift telemetry and pass countdowns
Antenna rotator tracking via Hamlib rotctld (Azimuth / Elevation)
Transceiver CAT tracking via rigctld and flrig with Click-to-Tune (QSY)

screenshot.caption: 9M2PJU ESPHamClock dashboard with Open HamClock Backend (OHB)

description.p: Release 4.29 with Open HamClock Backend (OHB), multi-resolution scaling, rotator control, and rig CAT integration.
